latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Market Research Copilot (L2) for Gate Info and News:

- Aggregates multi-dimensional market briefs across 12 read-only tools from Gate-Info and Gate-News.
- Triggers on comprehensive research scenarios: market overview, coin analysis/comparison, technicals, news, or risk checks.
- Strictly analyzes and generates structured, citation-backed reports—never triggers trading or fund-moving actions.
- Leverages 5-dimension signal stacking to robustly handle multi-intent research queries.
- Clear separation between data-driven analysis and investment advice; no execution functions included.
- Requires Gate-Info MCP server; no authentication or trading permissions necessary.
